entities.summary: Bernard Coard, a notable figure in the history of Grenada, associated with The Grenadian Revolution and US Invasion (1983–1984). Preceded by US invades Grenada (Operation Urgent Fury) — October 25, 1983 and Maurice Bishop executed by army faction — October 19, 1983. Their legacy influenced Post-Invasion Democratic Restoration.
